charts.title: Total production value of the sports industry in China from 2015 to 2021 (in billion yuan)
charts.short: Total scale of the sports industry in China 2015-2021
charts.description: In 2021, the total production value of the sports industry in China amounted to around 3.1 trillion yuan, representing an increase of almost 14 percent. In the past few years, the industry experienced a strong development from around 1.7 trillion yuan in 2015 to almost three trillion yuan in 2019.
charts.source: National Bureau of Statistics of China; State General Administration of Sports (China)

charts.title: Value added of sports industry in China from 2015 to 2021 (in billion yuan)
charts.short: Value added of sports industry in China 2015-2021
charts.description: In 2021, the value added of sports industry in China amounted to around 1.22 trillion yuan, more than double the value added in 2015. The total scale of sports industry in China that year exceeded 3.1 trillion yuan.
charts.source: National Bureau of Statistics of China; State General Administration of Sports (China)

charts.title: Breakdown of the sports market value in China in 2021, by category (in billion yuan)
charts.short: Breakdown of the sports market value in China 2021, by category
charts.description: In 2021, the sports services sector in China had a market value of around 1.66 trillion yuan, accounting for 53.2 percent of the total value of China's sports industry. That year, sports goods manufacturing amounted to 1.36 trillion yuan.
charts.source: National Bureau of Statistics of China Market value in billion yuan
categories: Sports equipment and related product manufacturing

charts.title: Penetration rate of fitness clubs in China from 2017 to 2022
charts.short: Penetration rate of Chinese fitness clubs 2017-2022
charts.description: In 2022, 5.06 percent of people living in China were members of fitness clubs. With growing awareness of health and fitness in the past few years, the gym sector experienced a period of prosperity, with the number of gym members increasing significantly since 2017.
charts.source: 36Kr; Shanghai University of Sport; styd.cn; Weber Shandwick

charts.title: Average cost of a personal fitness training session in China from 2017 to 2021 (in yuan)
charts.short: Average rate of a personal training session in China 2017-2021
charts.description: In 2021, the cost of a typical personal fitness training session in China amounted to 255.4 yuan. Unlike membership fees in fitness clubs, which dropped significantly since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic, the average rate for personal training sessions remained generally stable in the past five years. Personal training sessions were especially popular among female gym-goers, as men tend to exercise independently in fitness clubs.

charts.title: Prevalent life problems encountered by fitness service customers in China as of May 2022
charts.short: Leading concerns among Chinese gym-goers 2022
charts.description: A survey conducted in China in May 2022 concluded that more than 55 percent of fitness service customers were suffering from stressful work life with exposure to tension or depression. Over half of all respondents were also dissatisfied with their body shape or physique, while many also had chronic illnesses, poor lifestyles, or anxiety about their body images. All of these concerns were contributing factors to demands in gym memberships.
categories: Stressful work life, prone to emotional tension or depression
Subjective dissatisfaction with body shape or physique
Sub-healthy state, chronic illnesses such as cervical spondylosis
Body image and lifestyle anxiety caused by social media marketing
Poor habits or lifestyles such as staying up late and smoking
Poor work-life balance, lack of free time
Narrow social circle, in need of making more friends
Insufficient disposable income to meet spending needs

charts.title: Number of members at health & fitness clubs in 2019, by country (in millions)
charts.short: Countries with the most health/fitness club memberships 2019
charts.description: This statistic depicts the leading markets of the health club industry worldwide in regards to club membership in 2019. In that year, there were about 64.19 million health club members in the United States.

charts.title: Number of members in fitness clubs in China from 2017 to 2022 (in millions)
charts.short: Number of gym members in China 2017-2022
charts.description: In 2022, the number of fitness club members in China amounted to 71.45 million. Due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic and the subsequent lockdown measures throughout the year, gym memberships across China dropped more than three million between 2021 and 2022, while many service providers ran into financial difficulties. With growing awareness of health and fitness in the past few years, the gym sector experienced a period of prosperity before the pandemic, although its [...]
charts.source: 36Kr; Shanghai University of Sport; styd.cn; Weber Shandwick

charts.title: Prevalent fitness and exercise activities in China as of May 2022
charts.short: Leading fitness activities in China 2022
charts.description: A survey conducted in May 2022 concluded that more than 60 percent of participants in fitness activities in China had experience in aerobic exercises with equipment such as treadmills and ellipticals. Many other activities, including stretching, strength training with equipment, exercise bikes, and swimming were also among the most prevalent activities enjoyed by sports enthusiasts in China. More than one in four respondents also had experience in combat sports.
categories: Aerobic activities with equipment (treadmill, elliptical, etc.)
Workout with smaller gear (kettlebells, elastic bands, etc.)

charts.title: Annual average spending of member in fitness clubs and personal training studios in China in 2022 (in yuan per person)
charts.short: Annual expenditure of a member in sports establishments in China 2022
charts.description: In 2022, fitness club members in China spent around on average about 3,324 yuan per person in the whole year. The annual average expenditure of a member in fitness clubs and personal training studios dropped significantly since the outbreak of COVID-19 in almost all major cities in China.

charts.title: Gender distribution of fitness center goers in China in 2022
charts.short: Gender distribution of gym customers in China 2022
charts.description: Chinese female consumers are more likely to sign up for fitness classes and personal training in gyms than their male counterparts. In 2022, female customers accounted for almost 62 percent of all fitness studio memberships.
charts.source: 36Kr; Shanghai University of Sport; styd.cn; Weber Shandwick

charts.title: Age distribution of gym-goers in China in 2022
charts.short: Age distribution of gym customers in China 2022
charts.description: In China, 42.34 percent of gym members were aged between 26 and 35 years in 2022. In comparison, around 20 percent of gym-goers were between 19 and 25 years old.
charts.source: 36Kr; Shanghai University of Sport; styd.cn; Weber Shandwick Share of members

charts.title: Market size of the fitness club and studio sector in China from 2018 to 2021 with estimates until 2026 (in billion yuan)
charts.short: Market value of fitness clubs and studios in China 2018-2026
charts.description: In 2019, the fitness club market in China surpassed 70 billion yuan, increasing from 46.4 billion yuan in 2018. The fast-expanding fitness industry in China was estimated to maintain its growth and exceed 100 billion yuan in 2026.
charts.note: China; 2018 to 2021; *Estimates. One yuan equals approximately 0.14 U.S. dollars and 0.14 euros (as of December 2022). Read more

charts.title: Annual growth rate of fitness club and studio market in China from 2019 to 2021 with forecasts until 2026
charts.short: Growth of fitness club market in China 2019-2026
charts.description: In 2021, the fitness club market in China grew by 12.7 percent compared to the previous year. The market size of fitness clubs was forecasted to keep a steady growth and reach about 108.2 billion yuan in 2026.

charts.title: Total number of fitness clubs and fitness studios in China from 2019 to 2022
charts.short: Number of gyms in China 2019-2022
charts.description: In 2022, there were 85,149 gyms across China, including 39,620 fitness clubs and 45,529 fitness studios. The number of fitness clubs and fitness studios both dropped consistently in the past few years, largely due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic and the subsequent lockdown measures.
charts.source: 36Kr; Shanghai University of Sport; styd.cn; Weber Shandwick

charts.title: Leading fitness studio* brands in China as of 2021, based on number of studios
charts.short: Major fitness studios in China 2021, based on number of studios
charts.description: As of 2021, Zhongtian Fitness increased its offline fitness studios in China from 671 to 1043. Its closest domestical rival LEFIT owned 864 stores, up from 595 stores in the previous year. Apart from traditional gyms or fitness clubs, fitness studios provided personalized training plans to their members.
charts.note: China; 2021; * Differently from fitness clubs, fitness studios provide personalized workout plans and individual courses to their members. Yoga, boxing and EMS studios were not calculated. Figures based on the official data released from [...] Read more
charts.source: Shanghai University of Sport; styd.cn Number of fitness studios

charts.title: Average yearly cost of a fitness club membership in China from 2017 to 2021 (in yuan)
charts.short: Average cost of a fitness club annual pass in China 2017-2021
charts.description: In 2021, the average cost of a typical fitness studio membership in China increased to 1289.4 yuan per year. Due to growing competition in the health and fitness sector and the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, the price of annual memberships in Chinese fitness clubs dropped substantially since 2019.

charts.title: Retail trade revenue of sport and leisure articles in China from April 2011 to October 2023 (in billion yuan)
charts.short: Monthly retail sales of sport and leisure articles in China 2011-2023
charts.description: The graph shows the retail trade revenue of sport and leisure articles in China from April 2011 to October 2023. In the latest reported month, about 10.3 billion yuan had been generated from sport and leisure article retail sales in China.
charts.source: National Bureau of Statistics of China

charts.title: Size of fitness equipment market in China from 2016 to 2021 (in billion yuan)
charts.short: Sports equipment market size in China 2016-2021
charts.description: In 2021, the total value of the sports equipment market in China reached almost 55 billion yuan, representing an increase of 15 percent from the previous year. The market went through a period of significant expansion in the past five years, growing from less than 40 billion yuan in prior to 2018 to its current size.
charts.note: China; 2016 to 2021; * Estimate. Note: 1 yuan equals approximately 0.14 U.S. dollars and 0.14 euros (as of September 2022). Read more

charts.title: Sales value of sportswear in China from 2014 to 2021 (in billion yuan)
charts.short: China retail sales of sportswear 2014-2021
charts.description: In 2021, the sales revenue of sports apparel had reached around 371 billion yuan in China, significantly increasing from around 315 billion yuan in the previous year. In that year, Nike ranked first in terms of market share among all sportswear brands in China.

charts.title: Online market size of fitness products in China from 2014 to 2020 with an estimate for 2021 (in billion yuan)
charts.short: Value of online fitness product market in China 2014-2021
charts.description: In 2020, the market value of online sports equipment in China reached nearly 175 billion yuan, increasing from about 150 billion yuan in 2019. The market size was projected to reach approximately 200 billion in 2021.
charts.note: China; 2014 to 2020; *Estimate. One yuan equals approximately 0.15 U.S. dollars and 0.15 euros (as of July 2022). Read more

charts.title: Breakdown of the sportswear market in China in 2022, by brand
charts.short: Breakdown of the sportswear market in China 2022, by brand
charts.description: In 2022, Nike ranked first in the Chinese sportswear market, with a market share of 22.6 percent. Anta, the local sportswear brand, overtook Adidas to come in second with approximately 20.4 percent market share that year.

charts.title: Number of monthly active users (MAU) of online sports and fitness services in China from 2017 to 2021 (in millions)
charts.short: Online sports and fitness monthly active user number in China 2017-2021
charts.description: As of 2021, there were 138 million monthly active users (MAU) of online sports and fitness services in China, increasing from 36.1 million in 2017. Online sports and fitness services include livestreaming fitness courses and fitness apps.

charts.title: Size of the online sports and fitness market in China from 2015 to 2021 (in billion yuan)
charts.short: Online sports and fitness market size in China 2015-2021
charts.description: In 2021, the size of the online sports and fitness market in China reached almost 370 billion yuan, representing an increase of 17.5 percent from the previous year. The online sports fitness market enjoyed a period of prosperity in the past few years, thanks to the growing prevalence of smartphones and the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.

charts.title: Share of online and offline fitness services in the Chinese health and fitness market in 2022
charts.short: Distribution of the health and fitness market in China 2022, by type
charts.description: In 2022, offline fitness services such as fitness clubs and studios represented less than half of the overall health and fitness market in China, with online fitness services, such as fitness apps and live training sessions gaining more ground in the market. Despite the limitations of online fitness training, the popularity of online fitness services increased significantly in the past few years, thanks to the COVID-19 pandemic.

charts.title: Penetration rate of online fitness apps and live sessions in China from 2015 to 2022, with an estimate of 2027
charts.short: Penetration rate of online fitness services in China 2015-2027
charts.description: In 2022, the penetration rate of online fitness services such as apps and live training sessions amounted to 41.3 percent in China, representing a slight drop from the previous year. The online fitness sector expanded significantly in the past few years, especially since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic. However, with the lack of interactions between trainers and participants and the limited choices of equipment, traditional fitness clubs remained a better choice for most enthusiasts.
charts.note: China; 2015 to 2022; * Estimate Data prior to 2022 come from earlier publications. Read more

charts.title: Number of monthly active users (MAU) of the leading sports and fitness apps in China in November 2023 (in millions)
charts.short: Leading fitness apps by monthly active users in China 2023
charts.description: As of November 2023, Keep, an app providing online fitness programs, topped in the sports app ranking in China with about 14 million monthly active users. The success of Keep based on the combination of the Instagram-style social media and e-commerce functions. Apart from sports enthusiasts benefit from Keep, business brands also promote their sales in the app's own sports store and create social campaigns in the community space.
